_doc: STUDIO (2026-11-28, Mika : "faut reunir rytm arp et deckmix dans Studio ! et on doit pouvoir telecharger les full plugins quand on est dans studio") : les machines du site au meme endroit, avec le VST3 complet a telecharger. Lu par src/v4/ui/sections/Studio.tsx et scripts/prerender-seo.mjs.
lead: The machines of this site in one place. MM-RYTM and MM-ARP are also full VST3 plugins, free to download for Mac and Windows. MM-DECKS lives right here on the site.

machines.name: MM-RYTM
machines.text: 16 tracks, synth and sample layers, parameter locks, conditional trigs, per-track FX and two LFOs per voice.

machines.name: MM-ARP
machines.text: Two oscillators, sub, ladder filter, arpeggiator, chord pads, chorus, tape delay and reverb.

machines.name: MM-DECKS
machines.text: Two to four decks, the Maudite Machine tracks, SoundCloud and your own files, a mixer that also takes MM-RYTM and MM-ARP.
